description.narrative: The aim is to support the institutional integrity and independence of anti-corruption bodies by strengthening the capacities and expertise of prominent leaders in the anti-corruption sphere. It aims to launch an educational program for anti-corruption system personnel and representatives of Ukrainian CSO's and Media to foster the growth and development of human potential and to assist a network of professionals dedicated to developing stable, strong and trustworthy state institutions.
